rationale: The Latin anchors *ire*, *venire*, *gradi*, *procedere*, and *scandere* all point to motion/movement on foot (going, coming, walking, proceeding, climbing), which best aligns with step.v.01 (shift or move by taking a step). The OE *a-stígan* fundamentally means "to go up/ascend, to proceed," and step.v.01 captures the core sense of locomotion, while step.v.07 is too narrow (short distance) and step.v.10 is metaphorical.
